safety_review.findings: Fresh claude-opus-5-5 reviewer read all 13 banks, every option, all 3 alternatives in Thai and English against the case tree and every question variant. Sources: ACG 2024 acute pancreatitis guideline (via published summaries: moderate fluids reassessed by pulse, BP, urine and BUN; lactated Ringer over saline; early oral low-fat solid feeding over nil by mouth or a liquid-first step; CT for no improvement after 48-72 h), revised Atlanta 2012 criteria (lipase or amylase at least 3 times normal plus typical pain), WATERFALL (NEJM 2022) on fluid overload, CIWA-Ar symptom-triggered benzodiazepine dosing with parenteral thiamine, WHO AUDIT and brief intervention as named in the case review. Checked clinical truth, safety, leaks (no reply names a test, drug or diagnosis outside its option's label and line; acronym scan clean), fit to every variant, Thai-English equivalence. Writer flags judged: step4.W relative safety sentences are warranted (active withdrawal, pulse 118, PRN without a trigger) and name no alternative; npo replies frame nil by mouth as short-term comfort only and say a longer fast does not speed recovery, so they do not mislead; diet replies say a low-fat diet does little against a drinking-driven repeat and frame pancreatic load as intent, not effect; 'within a day' withdrawal onset reads true after every step-3 variant.
